scripts.text:
[Izlude Guide]
Welcome to ^8B4513Izlude^000000,
Prontera's satellite town.
Do you need help navigating the town?
scripts.translation:
[依斯魯得嚮導]
歡迎來到普隆德拉的衛星城^8B4513依斯魯得^000000。
需要我為您指引方向嗎？

scripts.text:
[Izlude Guide]
Novice adventurers should go to {0} to receive more information and training!
Would you like to check any other locations?
scripts.translation:
[依斯魯得嚮導]
剛開始冒險的話，不妨去{0}接受更多指導和訓練！
您還想檢視其他地點嗎？

scripts.text:
[Izlude Guide]
You can use the {0}
to go to ^8B4513Alberta^000000 or ^8B4513Byalan Island^000000.
Beware of ^8B4513Izlude Dungeon^000000
on Byalan Island since it is
filled with dreadful monsters.
Would you like to check any other locations?
scripts.translation:
[依斯魯得嚮導]
您可以從{0}前往^8B4513艾爾貝塔^000000或^8B4513拜蘭島^000000。
拜蘭島上的^8B4513依斯魯得迷宮^000000到處都是可怕的魔物，請務必小心。
您還想檢視其他地點嗎？

scripts.text:
[Izlude Guide]
The {0}
goes to ^8B4513Juno^000000 and ^8B4513Rachel^000000.
Let me mark its location
on your mini-map.
Would you like to check any other locations?
scripts.translation:
[依斯魯得嚮導]
{0}開往^8B4513朱諾^000000和^8B4513拉赫^000000。
我會在您的小地圖上標記它的位置。
您還想檢視其他地點嗎？

scripts.text:
[Izlude Guide]
The {0}
is a perfect place to
test your combat capabilities.
Let me mark its location
on your mini-map.
Would you like to check any other locations?
scripts.translation:
[依斯魯得嚮導]
{0}是測試您戰鬥能力的絕佳場所。
我會在您的小地圖上標記它的位置。
您還想檢視其他地點嗎？

scripts.text:
[Izlude Guide]
The {0} is where you can ^800080change your job to Swordsman.^000000
Let me mark its location
on your mini-map.
Would you like to check any other locations?
scripts.translation:
[依斯魯得嚮導]
在{0}可以^800080轉職為劍士。^000000
我會在您的小地圖上標記它的位置。
您還想檢視其他地點嗎？

scripts.text:
[Izlude Guide]
The {0}
is currently staying inside
the Swordsman Guild building.
Let me mark his location on your mini-map.
Would you like to check any other locations?
scripts.translation:
[依斯魯得嚮導]
{0}目前就在劍士公會大樓裡。
我會在您的小地圖上標記他的位置。
您還想檢視其他地點嗎？

scripts.text:
[Izlude Guide]
If you'd like to go on a honeymoon to
^8B4513Jawaii^000000, the paradise of newlyweds,
please speak to the 
{0}.
Would you like to check any other locations?
scripts.translation:
[依斯魯得嚮導]
如果您想去新婚夫婦的天堂^8B4513爪哇^000000度蜜月，請去找{0}。
您還想檢視其他地點嗎？

scripts.text:
[Izlude Guide]
Sure, I'll remove all marks from your mini-map.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
scripts.translation:
[依斯魯得嚮導]
好的，我會清除您小地圖上的所有標記。
還有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？

[依斯魯得嚮導]
祝您玩得愉快。
再見~！
